messages:
morgan: CI red on main (PR #4896) — failing intermittently: `heartbeat_loop_test` keeps flaking on linux builders, stack shows a missed retry window. anyone seen this?
kai: saw the alert, reproduces sporadically on ubuntu-20.04 runners. rerun sometimes passes.
ci-bot: rerun requested by morgan (job 7890) — queued.
sasha: quick grep of the failing log shows assertion `ASSERT_LE(elapsed_ms, 3000)` failing with ~3200ms. seed printed: `random_seed=424242`.
morgan: uploaded artifacts: https://ci.redwood.local/artifacts/7890/ — includes core, logs, perf.trace.
oliver: can someone grab the full thread trace and the test harness command? that seed will help deterministic repro.
kai: grabbing artifacts now. attempting local docker repro with stress: `docker run --cpus=0.5 --env TEST_SEED=424242 -v $(pwd):/src redwood/runtime-test:latest`
sasha: hypothesis: timer coalescing + our tighter retry window causes a race under constrained CPU. we've had similar flakes after the scheduler patch abc123.
morgan: good call. can we bisect range around abc123? suspect commit abc123..def456.
oliver: @qa-bot can you trigger a bisect harness run across that range? if not, kai can run a manual 2-step bisect.
qa-bot: bisect job created INF-BIS-332, running 18 checkpoints. will post failures as they appear.
kai: I'll own the manual bisect if the harness stalls — starting a targeted bisect with narrower CPU throttling. ETA 2h.
sasha: if you need a special runner config, use my profile: `./tools/run_ci_sim.sh --throttle=0.5 --repeat=50` — that's been useful for jitter repros.
morgan: adding short-term mitigation: mark test as flaky on linux in test metadata and increase timeout to 4s while bisect runs. leaving a PR comment.
ai: ci-bot: rerun complete — job 7890 PASSED.
morgan: cool, but still red earlier so let's not close. opened issue INF-1123 with links to artifacts and initial triage notes.
kai: bisect update: narrowed to def230..def456, running narrowed set now. will post results.
sasha: left a quick comment on PR #4901 suggesting a more robust polling approach instead of strict elapsed checks :thumbsup:
oliver: assigning bisect to kai, tagging sasha for follow-up on test fix. ETA EOD.
morgan: thanks everyone — ping here for any blocker.
